items.reason: Caches bounds until a new immutable tail segment is appended. Depth-leased per-tail capsule query scratch preserves target order, seen-mark timing and reentrant calls; unused queries allocate nothing.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization][P3] Blaster local knockback: reuse its validated distance instead of taking a second square root
items.reason: The eligibility and damage callbacks can mutate the public offset vector or distance method before impulse application. Reusing an earlier distance can therefore change knockback. The speculative change was reverted.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] BodyBalanceのゼロ到達補正で不要な親骨回転走査を省略
items.reason: Current reach correction still transforms a zero displacement through parent quaternions and adds it to each bone. Skipping this changes signed-zero and nonfinite propagation and private scratch/cache initialization; no finite-rig and state-equivalent shortcut was established. items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] ナイスダマ爆風の粒子試行・予告ルーン回転が描画FPS依存
items.reason: Converted charge and post-burst probability trials to the existing bounded 60 Hz cosmetic clock, reset fractional carry at burst and distance/phase exits, and retained exactly-once burst. The queue's accumulating-rune premise is false for PR1878: Director.disc overwrites v[7] from spin origin before follow each render, so the existing +0.02 is already a constant offset for spin=0. An actual retained-disc callback regression proves that behavior; preserved the original 60 Hz rune visual instead of introducing new rotation.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] ナイスダマ拡大リングが同一設置座標を約41回接地プローブする
items.reason: Ground queries have no immutable scene/version contract; caching ring probes would conceal geometry or callable changes. Keeping fresh probes avoids a visible floating or embedded ring.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] camera-rig-share-follow-yaw-sincos

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] カタログ塗りの既定上向き法線を1回だけ生成する

items.reason: The existing outer visibility/renderer finally is retained; a rejected warm promise is cleared only while still owned so synchronous, asynchronous and tier-build failures can retry.

items.reason: Current hem/tank/finger expressions have different multiplication order and public mutable state. A blanket zero-weight trig guard would alter nonfinite/signed-zero values; existing material-specific proven guards remain.

items.reason: Restored depth-leased actor hit candidate rows with ordered sorting, independent nested shots and reference release.

items.reason: Each active Charger flight reuses its own defense probe; different flights and nested queries remain independent.

items.reason: Exclusively valid account/** changes omit the separate game suite because the dedicated account workflow owns API/bundle/Worker validation. Empty, malformed, unavailable and mixed changes require game QA, including mixed account/documentation edits.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Composed CPU regression CIの実行入力変更検知漏れ
items.reason: Added the evidenced motion-profile/bank/path, fixture, build/composition/runtime-evidence and executed source-test inputs. Existing source and emitted comparisons, component benchmark and browser trace commands are unchanged.

items.reason: Contrary to the historical #1870 disposition, #1878 already composes arithmetic past-step skipping with exact boundary correction. The current queue-network-ui test verifies final bar/step/note times and RNG consumption.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] カニタンク連射弾の二重descriptor構築とスペシャル弾のdamage band再複製を削減
items.reason: Crab direct-only shots avoid building the unused splash fallback descriptor; newly constructed canonical band records are not cloned a second time.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Crab Tank newborn splash catch-up: detached queue / lost record recycling
items.reason: Newborn Crab splash catch-up advances only the new suffix on the real owning queue. Retired drops return to the real pool, old prefix ages are untouched, and clear during a paint callback cannot resurrect drops.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] カニタンク左右3組の脚アニメーションでsinをペア共有
items.reason: The base only cached the two independent sine expressions for idle phases. This local change shares a freshly computed native left sine for a present right leg when |angle| <= 65536 and 0 <= k <= 1. Large/nonfinite phases, absent left legs, custom sine functions and mid-pose function replacement retain the original right expression. Group and Math.sin getter order, custom call receiver, accumulated phase and pose clock remain unchanged. The requested presentation-only rounding difference is bounded by actual model-matrix comparisons.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] カニタンク転がり塗りの毎tick Vector3複製と命中ごとのopts生成を削減
items.reason: Movement-start vectors are depth-leased across moveActor/paint. Known native paint and network sinks reuse depth-owned stamp options, resetting/deleting face and clearing owner on exit. Custom sinks keep fresh options. Seed hashes are call-locally reused only while the primitive seed stays Object.is-equal; changed seeds and coercible object seeds retain their original timing.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] 録音BGM専用経路で不要な音楽Workerの先行生成を延期
items.reason: _startTimer exits until a non-streamed, live player exists; HTMLMediaElement-only playback does not allocate the procedural worker.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] 録音BGMのみの初期化では未使用の手続き型BGMエフェクトグラフを遅延生成
items.reason: Final composition moves the procedural effect graph into _ensureProceduralFx, called only before creating Player.

items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Defer speculative reverb prewarm until audio intent, and avoid sample-rate-mismatch work
items.reason: Retain eager IR preparation. Starting the one-shot worker only at AudioContext creation guarantees no prepared pair for that same synchronous init; the fallback then renders on the first gesture. The proposal requires measured non-regression of first audible latency, but no Safari/device A/B trace establishes that. take(ctx) already rejects wrong-rate PCM and disposes worker/timer ownership. items.title: # [QUEUE][INKWAVE][Optimization] Pages・Workers公開アーカイブの未使用 unversioned / revisioned 静的ファイル二重収録を精査・削減
items.reason: Read-only completed-tree audit verifies all declared artifacts and inventories final root/revisioned path, SHA256 and byte length. The isolated final production build has 1,071 identical pairs totaling 48,990,113 root logical bytes. No additional root URL deletion is proven safe. Mandatory startup/packaging gates read root modules/lightmaps; the Service Worker explicitly preserves separate mutable-root HTTP behavior; account dev routes explicitly serve both root and revisioned static paths. Removing roots from the tested artifact would break or weaken existing checks. A publish-only pruned copy would require its own old-document, direct-URL, offline/update and Workers routing evidence, absent here. The proposed blanket deletion is therefore not adopted. Existing proven volume deduplication remains; actual additional files/bytes removed are zero.
